title: Additional regulations for signs other than advertising signs
previewText:
C6-5 C6-7 C8

In the districts indicated, and within 200 feet of an arterial highway or a public park with an area of one-half acre or more, no permitted sign that is within view of such arterial highway or public park shall exceed 500 square feet of surface area.

Beyond 200 feet from such arterial highway or public park, the surface area of such signs may be increased one square foot for each linear foot such sign

blocks.html: Upon application, these requirements shall be waived, provided that the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission certifies that:
blocks.plainText: Upon application, these requirements shall be waived, provided that the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission certifies that:

blocks.html: (a)        such waiver is limited to a single, non-flashing sign that is located on a zoning lot not less than one and one-half acres; and
blocks.plainText: (a) such waiver is limited to a single, non-flashing sign that is located on a zoning lot not less than one and one-half acres; and

blocks.html: (b)        all other permitted signs located on such zoning lot that are subject to the provisions of this Section conform with all the sign regulations applicable in C1 Districts.
blocks.plainText: (b) all other permitted signs located on such zoning lot that are subject to the provisions of this Section conform with all the sign regulations applicable in C1 Districts.
